Procedures and Measurements:
The key measure used by the Group
for managing liquidity risk is the
ratio of net liquid assets to deposits
from customers. The daily liquidity
position is monitored, and regular
liquidity stress testing is conducted
under a variety of scenarios covering
both normal and more severe market
conditions.
Outcomes in 2023:
Maintained sufficient liquidity to meet its
liabilities when due under both normal
and stressed conditions without incurring
unacceptable losses or risking damage to
the Group’s reputation.
The liquidity coverage ratio was main-
tained at 202.1% and net stable funding
ratio at 128.9% as at the end of 2023.
